checks.name: Frontend loads and SPACEVOICE controls render in persistent profile + isolated context
Real join/presence, deterministic single offer, targeted offer/answer, bidirectional ICE, connected RTC, ontrack and inbound RTP bytes
Mute changes local audio track; deafen changes only local remote playback
Leave closes RTC, stops capture, detaches WS handlers, removes remote audio and peer on both clients
Reentry without reload has one active peer/audio/socket per client
Real WebSocket drop triggers peer cleanup and automatic reconnect/new join/new RTC
Different rooms via public session API remain isolated across browser contexts
BroadcastChannel local transport connects same-profile tabs with real RTC and no WS
BroadcastChannel remains partitioned: persistent profile and isolated context do not discover each other
3 independent contexts: 3 unique pairs, 2 connected peers/tracks/audios per client, RTP on every path, one shared capture and no duplicate offers
Mesh mute affects all senders sharing the local track; deafen silences all local remote audios only
C leaves: only its peers close; original A-B remains connected with RTP
C reenters: only its two pairs are recreated, existing A-B remains intact
4 independent contexts: 6 unique pairs, 3 connected peers and distinct remote streams/audios per client, bidirectional RTP on every pair
Four-client WS reconnect: fresh snapshot resyncs C, only its 3 pairs are rebuilt, unrelated mesh links remain intact
Mesh exit closes every peer/socket/audio and all local captures
BroadcastChannel three-tab mesh connects all 3 pairs using native WebRTC and no WS
Screen: explicit native/fallback capture distributes video to B with video RTP; correct source track, muted local preview and stable RTC
Screen: late C receives A screen automatically without another capture
Screen: A/B independent simultaneous shares; C selector focuses one screen; deafen includes system-share playback
Screen: fourth context joins and receives both active shares without recapture
Screen: stopping A removes only A share and its senders; B screen and all voice peers remain connected
Screen: sharer reconnect keeps the same live capture and resends it to all three peers
Screen: simultaneous A/B starts with forced real offer collision recover to stable, both screens reach C/D
Screen: native track ended path stops only local A share and clears remote previews
Screen: repeated stop/start leaves signaling stable and no duplicate active screen senders
Screen: wallpaper/custom appearance applies while screen playback and existing RTC remain live
Screen: total leave stops every display/microphone track and removes all videos; controls fit desktop/mobile
Audio: real devices enumerate without automatic capture; three contexts join with labelled input selectors and native RTC
Audio: local meter and independent remote speaking respond to native fake audio; one shared Context, no second playback graph
Audio: one native getUserMedia replacement updates A-B/A-C without new PCs/offers; old track ends and RTP continues
Audio: simulated input disappearance triggers one native default fallback; peers/RTP survive and repeated devicechange does not recapture
Audio: explicit mute metadata suppresses local speaking and reaches late fourth participant
Audio: participant volume changes only B playback; deafen mutes all locally and undeafen restores saved volumes
Audio: voice-only analysers exclude live screen/system audio; share remains active through runtime microphone change
Audio: native setSinkId default/nondefault selection tested for every remote voice and screen element
Audio: four-person participant list, compact controls, meter and screen fit desktop/mobile without horizontal overflow
Audio: leave closes Context/disconnects nodes/cancels meter loop/device listener; rejoin has exactly one loop and one monitor per voice, volume restored
Audio: total cleanup leaves no active AudioContext, device listener or analyser loop
